Read native reporting support without renormalizing its physical domain

Source: R/reporting_support.R
read_reporting_support.Rd

Read native reporting support without renormalizing its physical domain

Usage

read_reporting_support(
  bundle,
  role = c("partition", "footprints"),
  require_layers = TRUE
)

Arguments

bundle

A bundle returned by build_reporting_support(), or the path to a complete bundle saved with saveRDS(). The canonical geometries, inventory and domain remain together in that artifact.

role

Select the disjoint reporting partition or all inventory footprints, including explicitly excluded alternatives. Footprints are marked as overlap and must not be summed as a physical partition.

require_layers

Require supplied water and ice, as in read_polycell_support(). Set FALSE explicitly for geometry-only study.

Value

A tibble carrying domain_land_area_ha alongside polity areas.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("sf", quietly = TRUE)) {
  g <- polycell_example_geometries()
  d <- sf::st_sf(domain_source = "example", year = 2010L,
                  geometry = sf::st_union(g))
  i <- tibble::tibble(source = "example", year = 2010L,
                     reporting_polity_code = g$polity_code)
  b <- suppressWarnings(build_reporting_support(i, d, g))
  read_reporting_support(b, require_layers = FALSE)
}
